purpose: Pin the exact tractable boundary inside the positive P0 witness carrier. When every clause has at most two witness options, the problem is 2-SAT/SCC. The first 3-option clause introduces ExactOne_3, which is not bijunctive and cannot be represented exactly by any local existential 2-CNF gadget.

rank2_terminal.setting: Every clause block has size at most two. Ground elements are literal occurrences; opposite-sign occurrence pairs are forbidden exactly as in the P0/P3-overlap carrier.
construction: For each two-option clause C create one Boolean choice bit y_C; unit clauses are fixed choices.
For every forbidden pair of occurrences o in C and p in D, add the 2-CNF clause NOT(C chooses o) OR NOT(D chooses p). Each choice predicate is one literal of y_C or y_D.
The resulting formula has linear size under occurrence degree at most three and is satisfiable iff a sign-consistent one-witness-per-clause transversal exists.
rank2_terminal.algorithm: Run the standard implication-graph SCC algorithm. W(F)>0 iff no choice bit and its negation lie in the same SCC. Witness reconstruction is linear-time from the SCC topological order.
rank2_terminal.meaning: The all-2-clause source-aligned P0 coefficient decision problem is polynomial even though the Hall subset-rank criterion from v2.9 can give false positives. Orientation/implication information, not rank alone, is the essential rank-2 invariant.

rank3_break.relation: ExactOne_3={100,010,001} on the three visible witness bits of a 3-option clause.
rank3_break.majority_counterexample: Coordinatewise majority of 100,010,001 is 000, which is not in ExactOne_3.

theorem.name: EXACTONE3_IS_NOT_BIJUNCTIVE_AND_HAS_NO_LOCAL_EXISTENTIAL_2CNF_REALIZATION
proof: A Boolean relation is bijunctive iff it is preserved by coordinatewise majority.
ExactOne_3 is not majority-closed by the explicit three-tuple counterexample.

Relations definable by a 2-CNF formula with existential auxiliary variables are primitive-positive projections of bijunctive relations; majority preservation is closed under conjunction and existential projection.
Therefore ExactOne_3 has no exact local 2-CNF gadget, regardless of the number of local auxiliary Boolean variables.

algorithmic_consequence.positive: There is a complete deterministic SCC/min-max terminal for the rank<=2 clause-choice carrier.
killed: Extend the rank-2 implication/SCC solver to 3-option clauses by replacing each ExactOne_3 clause with a fixed or polynomial-size local existential 2-CNF gadget.
Treat the rank3 jump as a mere encoding inconvenience in the choice bits.
not_killed: A genuinely global 2-CNF-equivalent transformation coupling many 3-clauses at once (which would itself constitute the desired breakthrough).
A three-layer claw blossom augmentation theorem.

next_target.name: E8_RANK3_ORIENTED_CLAW_BLOSSOM_V3_5
next_target.directive: Use the rank-2 SCC theorem as the exact baseline. A valid rank-3 augmentation must explain how a 3-option clause is contracted into the implication structure without a local bijunctive gadget and with a polynomial global progress measure. Equivalently, find a nonlocal oriented-P0/Pfaffian identity that resolves many ExactOne_3 defects simultaneously.

sources: T. J. Schaefer, The Complexity of Satisfiability Problems, STOC 1978.
Standard polymorphism characterization: a Boolean relation is bijunctive iff it is preserved by the Boolean majority operation.
